recognize_zh: 中央細胞邊緣不規則，細胞質與核上覆蓋大量大小不一、深紫黑色的粗顆粒，把淡紫色分葉核遮得模糊不清；這種顆粒蓋住核的外觀就是嗜鹼性球。
features: Granulocyte about the size of a neutrophil with irregular outline
Numerous coarse, variably sized dark purple-black granules
Granules overlie and obscure a pale, lobulated nucleus
Nearby platelets and clumped platelet fragments; normochromic red cells
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte packed with coarse, irregularly sized, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure a pale lobulated nucleus. The cell outline is slightly irregular. Scattered platelets and small platelet clumps are present among normochromic red cells. Findings are consistent with a basophil; persistent absolute basophilia should prompt evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm, particularly CML.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger tissue cells with a round, central non-lobulated nucleus and densely packed uniform granules, and are rarely seen in blood.
Eosinophils have uniform round orange-red granules that do not obscure the clearly bilobed nucleus.
Toxic neutrophils have finer dark granules in pink cytoplasm with a clearly visible multilobed nucleus.
